description: SLA uptime and downtime calculator — Turn availability percents into allowed downtime per day/week/month/quarter/year (sla= comma-separated, e.g. 99.9,99.95), count the nines, and compute composite availability of dependent services (mode=serial, all must be up) or redundant ones (mode=parallel). Optional downtime= (43m, 1h20m, 90s or minutes) with period=day|week|month|quarter|year shows achieved availability, whether each SLA was met, remaining budget or overage. Offline, instant. Price: $0.001 USDC (Base, via x402).
name: util_sla
